sense: a chance of something in the future

evidence: Cic. Fam. 14.4.3: sī est spēs nostrī reditūs
terms.comment: A good prospect is a hope: spēs with a genitive of what is hoped for. It is the everyday word for hope (see hope).

evidence: Cic. Tusc. 4.80: sī spēs est exspectātiō bonī, malī exspectātiōnem esse necesse est metum (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: The waiting for something, good or bad; a bad prospect is a fear, metus.

phrases.latin: sī est spēs nostrī reditūs, eam cōnfīrmēs et rem adjuvēs
phrases.english: if there is any prospect of my return, strengthen it and help the matter along

phrases.latin: cum in spem magis futūrae multitūdinis quam ad id quod tum hominum erat mūnīrent
phrases.english: for they built their walls for the prospect of a future population rather than for the people they had then
